HomePage.title: የ ESTQB ኢትዮጵያ ማረጋገጫ መድረክ
HomePage.description: The Ethiopian Software Testing Qualifications Board (ESTQB) is the official national board dedicated to advancing software quality. We provide internationally recognized certifications that validate your QA expertise, standardize industry practices, and connect Ethiopian talent to global opportunities. (በአማርኛ)
HomePage.statCountriesDesc: በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ እውቅና ያላቸው ደረጃዎች
HomePage.statCertifiedDesc: በኢትዮጵያ ጥራት ያለው ሶፍትዌር እንዲኖር ማገዝ
HomePage.whyChooseSub: In a rapidly evolving tech landscape, standing out is essential. ESTQB certifications are the gold standard in software testing, offering unparalleled benefits for your professional growth. (በአማርኛ)
HomePage.val1Desc: Achieving an ESTQB certification means your credentials are valid and respected by top-tier technology companies and employers in over 130 countries worldwide. It serves as an international passport for your QA career. (በአማርኛ)
HomePage.val2Desc: Master structured testing techniques, best practices, and agile methodologies based on industry-leading global curricula. Our syllabi ensure you speak the same technical language as testers anywhere in the world. (በአማርኛ)
HomePage.val3Desc: Connect with a rapidly growing network of qualified QA professionals in Ethiopia. Gain access to exclusive industry events, continuous learning resources, and career advancement opportunities. (በአማርኛ)
HomePage.certSub: በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ተቀባይነት ባላቸው የሙከራ ትምህርቶቻችን ዛሬ ጉዞዎን ይጀምሩ።
HomePage.journeySub: የእርስዎን ዓለም አቀፍ የQA እውቅና ለማግኘት አራት ቀላል ደረጃዎች።
HomePage.step1Desc: ፈተናዎችዎን መከታተል ለመጀመር የእጩነት መገለጫዎን ይፍጠሩ።
HomePage.step2Desc: ኦፊሴላዊ የስርዓተ ትምህርት ቁሳቁሶችን ያውርዱ እና በስልጠና ክፍለ ጊዜዎች ላይ ይሳተፉ።
HomePage.step3Desc: ጥብቅ የመስመር ላይ ወይም ከመስመር ውጭ ፈተናዎን ያቅዱ እና ያጠናቅቁ።
HomePage.step4Desc: በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ሊረጋገጥ የሚችል የምስክር ወረቀትዎን ያግኙ እና ስራዎን ያሳድጉ።
HomePage.newsSub: በQA ማስታወቂያዎች፣ ጠቃሚ ምክሮች እና የኢንዱስትሪ አዝማሚያዎች ወቅታዊ መረጃ ያግኙ።
HomePage.ctaDesc: በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ የተረጋገጡ የሶፍትዌር መፈተሻ ባለሙያዎችን ይቀላቀሉ እና በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ አዳዲስ የስራ እድሎችን ያግኙ።
HomePage.whoWeAreSub: Elevating the standards of software engineering across Ethiopia. (በአማርኛ)
HomePage.whoWeAreDesc1: As a member of the International Software Testing Qualifications Board (ISTQB), we are responsible for ensuring that software testing professionals in Ethiopia have access to the highest quality, standardized, and globally recognized certification schemes. Our mission is to promote the value of software testing as a critical profession. (በአማርኛ)
HomePage.whoWeAreDesc2: Whether you are a university student just starting your QA journey, or a seasoned professional looking to validate your expertise, ESTQB provides the resources, syllabi, and examinations necessary to achieve your career goals. (በአማርኛ)

Footer.description: በኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ ይፋዊ የሶፍትዌር ሙከራ ማረጋገጫ አካል። በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ እውቅና ባላቸው የምስክር ወረቀቶች የጥራት ደረጃዎችን ከፍ ማድረግ።
Footer.rights: ESTQB ኢትዮጵያ። መብቱ በህግ የተጠበቀ ነው።
